title: Total Error Sheets for Datasets (TES-D) A Critical Guide to Documenting Online Platform Datasets
reasoning: The paper introduces the TES-D framework, which integrates explicit ethical considerations throughout various stages of data documentation, including questions on ethics review processes, potential risks to individuals (psychological distress, sensitive information), consent, data protection, and the potential for the dataset to contribute to social inequality or misuse. These are not merely brief mentions but integral components of the proposed documentation guide, as demonstrated by detailed questions and discussions in the manual and example appendix.
